meta.title: Zhihu Search
meta.description: Zhihu in-site search, global web search, and Zhida answers for the model, over the official Zhihu Open Platform API.

en.hideNativeWebHint: Visibility only — tool-web still loads. Takes effect next request; no restart.
en.hideNativeWebOff: Native web search stays visible to the model.
en.hideNativeWebOn: The model sees only the three Zhihu tools.
en.readOnly: This connection does not allow writing settings.
